title: Kinematics: Rest, Motion, and Trajectories

sections.title: Position, Displacement, Speed, Velocity, and Graph Slope/Area
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Establish the fundamental distinction between path-dependent scalar quantities and path-independent vector quantities in 1D.

sections.title: Acceleration, Derivation of Constant Acceleration Equations, Calculus Integration, Free Fall
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Extend kinematic analysis to accelerated systems using calculus, culminating in standard equations for uniform acceleration and motion under gravity.

sections.title: 2D Orthogonal Motion, Ballistic Trajectories, Tower Projection, and Inclined Plane Projection
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Apply the principle of independent orthogonal motions to complex 2D ballistic trajectories, generalizing from flat ground to inclined constraints.

sections.title: 1D & 2D Relative Velocity, River-Swimmer, Rain-Umbrella, and Closest Approach
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Synthesize vector addition and subtraction principles within inertial reference frames to analyze multi-body interactions.

pedagogical_synthesis_notes: Progression is structured logically from 1D scalar/vector distinction to complex 2D relative motion.
Section 3 heavily emphasizes decoupling 2D motions into independent 1D problems, laying groundwork for force resolution later.
